name: Diana Helm

bio.statement: The county board page says Helm served as mayor of the former City of Damascus and as a city council member and president.
bio.excerpt: She served as Mayor of the former City of Damascus, as well as City Council member and President.

bio.statement: A county news release says Helm was appointed Clackamas County Commissioner, Position 4, in May 2025.
bio.excerpt: Diana Helm has been appointed as Clackamas County Commissioner, Position #4.

bio.statement: Helm's pamphlet statement lists business ownership of Terra Casa and work as a principal buyer for Fred Meyer.
bio.excerpt: Business Owner: Terra Casa; Fred Meyer: Principle Buyer

positions.statement: Helm's pamphlet statement says she supports increasing affordable housing while reducing unnecessary regulatory burdens.
positions.excerpt: Diana supports increasing affordable housing while reducing unnecessary regulatory burdens

positions.statement: Helm's pamphlet statement says she led the effort for a moratorium on large data centers.
positions.excerpt: she led the effort for a moratorium on large data centers

positions.statement: Helm's pamphlet statement says she will continue working to address root causes of homelessness and addiction.
positions.excerpt: Diana will continue working to address the root causes of homelessness and addiction

positions.statement: Helm's pamphlet statement says economic growth and a strong business climate are key to creating and retaining family-wage jobs.
positions.excerpt: Diana knows economic growth and a vibrant business climate are key to creating and retaining family-wage jobs

positions.statement: Helm's campaign site says ensuring the justice system works well for all citizens is a priority.
positions.excerpt: Ensuring our justice system works well for all of our citizens is a priority.

positions.statement: In an OPB candidate questionnaire on affordability, Helm says commissioners can choose not to add new taxes or fees.
positions.excerpt: But as commissioners, we can choose not to add new taxes or fees.

positions.statement: In the OPB questionnaire, Helm says sheriff's office costs have grown faster than revenue, creating a gap that needs to be addressed.
positions.excerpt: At the same time, costs have grown faster than our revenue, creating a gap that needs to be addressed.

collection_notes: Incumbent (appointed May 2025) per localofficials.html and county news release (inventory_fixes). This race fills the remainder of the term (2-year). Pamphlet spells 'Principle Buyer' (sic). KGW/KOIN/KPTV hits are 2025 appointment coverage or primary results; not used.
